serveUploadOrAsset.reason: Owned-image resolution and permission use the bounded scalar visitor boundary when enabled; the literal resolver and readable closure run when disabled. Resolution errors fail at the existing not-found boundary before attachment fallback. TestScaleP21HotOAuthLogoAccessDifferential and OwnedImageBoundary verify shared resolution and authorization.

serveSignedFile.reason: After the unchanged signature check, owned images use the bounded scalar resolution boundary without repeating membership authorization, matching the original signed URL behavior. Flag-off retains the literal resolver. TestScaleP21HotOAuthLogoOwnedImageBoundary covers the no-permission resolution mode.
serveSignedFile.temperatureReason: Signed files are reached by ordinary image views.

fileReadable.reason: Owned-image permission uses the bounded pinned scalar visitor and rejects errors before the unchanged account/attachment fallback. Flag-off invokes the original image resolver/readable closure. TestScaleP21HotOAuthLogoAccessDifferential and OwnedImageBoundary exercise the identical shared boundary.
fileReadable.temperatureReason: File signing and reads authorize images during ordinary views.

createFileUpload.reason: Trusted identity-only scope resolves the workspace key; original actor, filename/type/size validation and durable upload quota writer remain unchanged. TestScaleP21M2CredentialsAndUploadDifferential compares response fields and canonical uploader/workspace/purpose binding with zero full decodes.
